grades: Entering 10 to 12 for high school courses (7 to 9 for middle school courses)
notes: Questions: ExploreASC@osu.edu or 614-292-6390. The page text was cut off before the money help details. Ask the program if aid is offered. Other department camps are on the department summer page. They cover philosophy, language science, humanities and mind science.
name: Arts and Sciences Summer Exploration Program
org: The Ohio State University College of Arts and Sciences
what_you_do: You take one one-week course on campus, taught by Ohio State faculty, staff and graduate students. Classes meet 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Monday to Friday and are not for grades or credit.
who_can_apply: Students entering grades 10 to 12 in fall 2027 can take high school courses.
pay_detail: The 2026 fee was $550 per one-week course, with lunch and snacks. The 2027 fee is not posted.
deadline_text: Check back in early January 2027 for the summer 2027 course list and registration form.
how_to_apply: Make a free account in the online application system. Then apply. Sign up for updates on the program page to learn when applications open.
